content: Official WordPress guidance for untrusted request and uploaded data requires capability and nonce checks, input sanitization/validation, late context-appropriate output escaping, and useful error handling. The core importer flow demonstrates explicit file selection/upload/import. GigPress already accepts CSV, checks nonce in handlers, reports parse/upload errors and per-row inserted/skipped/duplicate counts; improve layout and summary while retaining CSV schema and deterministic row-level feedback. Confidence MEDIUM: official docs checked against existing handlers.
